title: Will national renewable costs continue declining?
abstract: arXiv:2611.33978v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Since the 1980s, the global average solar photovoltaic (PV) cost has decreased by about two orders of magnitude while the global average onshore wind cost has decreased by about one order of magnitude. But global averages are only part of the story: For both solar and wind, costs vary between countries by about an order of magnitude. We curate a comprehensive database of national costs and build predictive models for future costs by decomposing the levelized cost of electricity (LCOE) into its components at the national level and modeling them separately. For solar we find that since 1990 the module cost and the balance of system (BOS) cost have both declined roughly exponentially at rates of 12% per year. In contrast, wind turbine cost has declined roughly exponentially by 4% per year, while BOS cost has not declined at all. This suggests that total global wind cost will approach a floor cost of about 35 USD/MWh, reaching about 43 USD/M

translated_title: 国家可再生能源成本会继续下降吗？
translated_abstract: 自20世纪80年代以来，全球平均太阳能光伏（PV）成本已下降了约两个数量级，而全球平均陆上风电成本已下降了约一个数量级。但全球平均值只是故事的一部分：对于太阳能和风能而言，各国之间的成本差异约达一个数量级。我们整理了一个全面的国家层面成本数据库，并通过在国家层面将平准化度电成本（LCOE）分解为各个组成部分并分别建模，构建了未来成本的预测模型。对于太阳能，我们发现自1990年以来，组件成本和系统平衡（BOS）成本均以每年约12%的速率大致呈指数级下降。相比之下，风机成本以每年约4%的速率大致呈指数级下降，而BOS成本则完全没有下降。这表明全球总体风电成本将接近约35美元/兆瓦时的底限成本，达到约43美元/兆瓦时（摘要原文在此处似乎被截断）。
tldr: 该论文通过整理各国可再生能源成本数据库并将LCOE分解为组件成本与BOS成本分别建模，发现太阳能成本自1990年以来以每年约12%的速率持续指数下降，而风电因BOS成本未见下降，其全球成本将趋于约35美元/兆瓦时的底限。
en_tdlr: By curating a comprehensive national-level renewable cost database and decomposing LCOE into module and balance-of-system components, this paper finds that solar costs have declined exponentially at ~12% per year since 1990, while wind costs will approach a floor of ~35 USD/MWh due to stagnant balance-of-system costs.
